title: Astronomers discover a strange universal rule behind black hole eruptions
caption:
Supermassive black holes millions of times heavier than our sun trigger delayed energy jets at the exact same feeding threshold as tiny ones. New research tracking shredded stars reveals why some cosmic giants stay quiet for years before erupting.

Source: Sciencedaily - Astronomers discover a strange universal rule behind black hole eruptions
